objects.triage_title: RN3-20260917-b9c2 RN-JOINT-001: joint Gaussian comparison bounding the full far-region saddle intensity at r=1/20
objects.triage_summary: A single nine-dimensional joint Gaussian chi-square comparison bounds the far-region marked saddle intensity ratio by 0.88021 < rho/rho_ref < 1.12058 at r=1/20, below the 0.6798 budget. The comparison uses the exact typed second moment and covers all 13,604 boxes of 5<=|y|<=17 and the full mark window. This gives 2.22542 r^3 < I_far < 2.83312 r^3. The proof note, the Arb 384-bit certificate JSON and the report all state these figures; the near annulus and all-small-r cases remain open.
